newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $1.2 bln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $1.2 bln for Wednesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday, July 30 were expected to total $1.2 billion in 32 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings totalled $858 million in 18 sales, with a $340 million California Natural Resources offering through PaineWebber Inc topping the list.
On the competitive side, 14 sales totaling $370 million were scheduled. A $250 million Maryland offering at 1100 EDT was the largest.
An additional six sales totaling $122 million were on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Wednesday depending on market conditions.
